sentences.text:
======================================================
 SAURAV KUMAR Son of Anil Chaurasiya Resident of village - Manjhway,
 P.S. - Hisua, Distt. - Nawada (Bihar)
 ... ... Petitioner/
 Versus  THE STATE OF BIHAR  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Anil Chandra, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Raj Kishor Singh, APP  =====
ORAL ORDER 2 21-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Buniyadganj P.S. Case No.38 of 2023 instituted under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468 of the IPC lodged on 02.02.2023 by the informant Raju Kumar.

As per the FIR, the informant Raju Kumar has filed a written report before S.H.O. Buniyaganj Police Station alleging therein that the informant is running a mobile shop in the name of Sri Ram Laxman at Kalali Road, Manpur and deal with mobile Sim Card as well as he transferred money from Aadhar- card.

On 22.11.2022, one person came to his shop as a customer and said his thumb impression is not working therefore, made request to transfer money on mobile number of informant through PAYTM and offered to pay him in cash after deducting Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.31372 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 his commission.
On query, he did not disclosed his name.

Accordingly, money was transferred from his mobile no.
7859087307 to the mobile no. 9006196426 of informant through PAYTM of Rs. 710/-, 60/- on 11.11.2022, Rs. 1/- and 10,000/- on 17.12.2022, Rs. 25,000/- on 18.12.22, and Rs. 34,800/- on 19.12.22.
In the meantime, he found his bank account no. 00098100041740 of Bank of Baroda showing minus Rs. 5,00,000.

Upon query, the bank informed him that the cyber- criminal has transferred Rs. 34,800/- in the account and as such the account has been freezed.

On 02.02.2023, at 06.30 the informant was at his shop and saw that the person who had cheated him, the informant called him and as he wanted to interrogate, the accused tried to escape but the informant caught him with the help of local people and informed to the police.
The police came and on query, he disclosed his name as Tinku Kumar aged about 22 years, son of Ganesh Barai, of village- Manjway, P.S. Hisua, District- Nawada.
The informant also found that the mobile no. 8961258237 was in the name of Vikash Kumar which was done on forged 'Aadhar' card.
Accordingly, the FIR.

For the proper appreciation of the case, let a legible Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.31372 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 copy of the case diary be called for from the court of learned A.C.J.M.,VIII,
Gaya in connection with Buniyadganj P.S. Case No.38 of 2023.
Put up in due course.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Prakash Narayan /-
